**No more "WebSocket connection failed" on the Errors page.**

When no agent was running the Artspo MCP server, Chrome logged each of the extension's once-a-minute checks as an error, so `chrome://extensions` showed Artspo with **Errors** even though nothing was wrong. Artspo now checks quietly first and only opens the connection when the server answers. Nothing else changes: agents still connect as soon as their server starts.

To clear the old errors, click **Clear all** on Artspo's Errors page after updating.

### Updating

`git pull`, then click ↻ on Artspo in `chrome://extensions`.

### Files

- `artspo-0.9.1.zip`: the whole repo (extension, skill, MCP server, docs). Use this one.
- `artspo-extension-0.9.1.zip`: just the `extension/` folder, the Chrome Web Store upload.

Requires Chrome 118+ on macOS (Linux works; Windows isn't supported). [5-minute tutorial](https://github.com/bryfeng/artspo/blob/main/docs/TUTORIAL.md) · [artbook.dev](https://artbook.dev/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=release&utm_campaign=artspo)
